transformations.description: Removed ANSI/control noise only; retained the complete authentic historical failed-job log without changing failure semantics.

Replaced ONLY the maintainer's personal email address in the TO literal with [SANITIZED_PERSONAL_EMAIL]. All 59 lines are retained at their original line numbers and no other byte differs from the exact revision. This supersedes an earlier transformation that had additionally replaced SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD, HOST and the FROM address. Those four replacements were reversed because they removed no secret and destroyed causal evidence: the committed username and password are the literal placeholder strings 'username' and 'password', the host is the public documented AWS SES endpoint email-smtp.us-west-2.amazonaws.com, and FROM is a public project role address. Worse, [SANITIZED_SMTP_HOST] is not resolvable, so the sanitized source predicted a name-resolution failure rather than the 535 authentication rejection the log actually records.
Replaced the maintainer's personal email address in the copyright header with [SANITIZED_EMAIL_ADDRESS]. Header text only; all 132 lines and every functional byte are unchanged.
